title: Moderated AI Development Workflow (MOD-W)
summary: MOD-W is a human-in-the-loop methodology for AI-assisted software development. It separates product, technical, implementation, and QA responsibilities across documented, Moderator-approved Steps.

principles.title: Role separation
principles.summary: Product, Tech Lead, Development Team, and QA responsibilities stay distinct throughout the workflow.

principles.title: Document-centered steps
principles.summary: Work is defined and reviewed through explicit documents and small, approved Steps.

principles.title: Human moderation
principles.summary: A human Moderator holds final authority over scope, approval, and direction.

principles.title: Review and validation
principles.summary: Implementation goes through Tech Lead review and QA validation before acceptance.
